payload.detail: UPDATE 2026-09-26 (owner decisions relayed via the coordinator, 'yes to all five'; offline, no provider access; PR #3067): Owner approved registering St Vincent de Paul Society (WA) and Youth Focus and governing vinnies.org.au and youthfocus.com.au. Passages Perth (SVC-YTH-017), Passages Peel (SVC-YTH-018) and Youth Focus (SVC-YTH-019) written from the operators' own pages; pending the owner's clinical sign-off. PRIOR DETAIL: UPDATE 2026-09-26 (owner-approved page reads from the cloud session, no provider access): Still blocked, and the earlier 'publisher blocker removed' note was incomplete. The City of Vincent Passages page (vincent.wa.gov.au/community/your-community/youth/passages.aspx) now returns 404, and no Department of Communities page describing Passages was found. The operator's own page (vinnies.org.au, St Vincent de Paul Society (WA) Inc) gives Passages Perth (143 Edward St, 08 9228 1478) and Passages Peel (20 Davey St Mandurah, 08 9583 5160), ages 12 to 25, with hours, but states no date; the publisher is not registered and vinnies.org.au is not a governed host. Youth Focus is likewise unregistered and youthfocus.com.au is ungoverned. NEXT: owner decision on registering St Vincent de Paul Society (WA) and Youth Focus and governing their hosts (both are decisions the owner has so far declined or not made), or leave these three unwritten. PRIOR DETAIL: RECHECKED 2026-09-25 on main 2c787a506: still no Passages Perth, Passages Peel or Youth Focus record in src/lib/services-canonical-data/ or source-acquisitions.json. The cloud session's network egress refuses every publisher host (wa.gov.au, mhc.wa.gov.au, aihw.gov.au, ruah.org.au, youthfocus.com.au, passages.org.au, healthdirect.gov.au and others all returned connect_rejected on 2026-09-25), and the sources skill forbids taking a publisher, date or contact detail from anywhere but the publisher's own page, so this cannot be done from a cloud session. TO UNBLOCK: run it from an unrestricted network, for example a Remote Control session on the owner's PC, or have the owner approve each page fetch. PRIOR DETAIL: REVIEW 2026-09-25 (offline audit of current main; no provider access): The publisher blocker is gone: PR #2880 (0bf2488d5) registered them (source-authority-registry.ts, catalogueIdentityOnly). The claim that Passages Youth Engagement Hub and the two others 'now appear in the clinical sign-off queue' is false: no Passages record exists in src/lib/services-canonical-data/ or source-acquisitions.json, and c68c6ff41 says they were deliberately absent. Next action: capture those service records and their sources. Lowered to P2 because nothing is blocked any more. PRIOR DETAIL: BLOCKER REMOVED 2026-09-18 (PR #2880, merged); THE DECISION IS STILL THE OWNER'S, which is why this row stays open. Both publishers the three WA services depend on are now registered in source-authority-registry.ts as named agencies: Department of Communities (WA) and City of Vincent. They are deliberately NOT the 'Government of Western Australia' catch-all an earlier block refused — a catch-all resolves every WA government document to one authority, whereas these two resolve only their own material. Both are catalogueIdentityOnly: true, so they are excluded from runtime retrieval classification and ranking is unchanged. WHAT IS LEFT IS THE OWNER DECISION THIS ROW ASKS FOR: registering a publisher admits no source. Passages Youth Engagement Hub and the two others still enter as unreviewed candidates at D band and cite nothing until signed off. They now appear in the clinical sign-off queue at /mockups/development/clinical-sign-off under Sources, which is where that decision can be worked.
